name: vsclaudecode
description: Unofficial Claude Code chat panel for VS Code - the VSClaude experience (per-message model attribution, model management, usage limits, auth recovery) powered by your installed Claude Code CLI. Not affiliated with Anthropic's official extension.

commands.title: VSClaude Code: Add Selection to Chat

vsclaudecode.claudeExecutablePath.description: Full path to the Claude Code CLI (claude.exe / claude). Empty = auto-detect from ~/.local/bin and PATH.

vsclaudecode.defaultModel.description: Model for new conversations (empty = CLI default).

vsclaudecode.showPreviousModels.description: Show superseded model versions under "Other models" in the model picker.

vsclaudecode.autoUpdateCli.description: Run `claude update` in the background once per window so the CLI and its model catalog stay current.

vsclaudecode.showForeignSessions.description: List conversations stored under other workspaces' history in a collapsed "From other folders" group in the session picker. Clicking one brings it into the current workspace.

vsclaudecode.enableRemoteSharing.description: Automatically connect every new conversation to claude.ai Remote Control (continue from web, the Claude app, or your phone). Requires a signed-in Claude CLI. The antenna button toggles sharing per conversation.

vsclaudecode.logProtocol.description: Log the CLI stream-JSON protocol to the VSClaudeCode output channel.
